sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified your demand forecast and cost model, though our head office has strictly frozen direct price reductions. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. 

However, by accepting your proposed 24-month contract term and 90-day payment period, we can adjust the overall package value. This allows us to offer a revised unit price of €432.15. Specifically, our Angebot comprises a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

decisions.tactician: o1 ties with E0 for our lowest cost and sits exactly at its health price, so the supplier keeps a sustainable margin and no relationship charge applies. The two-year term matches our horizon and delivers the volume commitment the supplier wants. E0's 36-month term adds nothing to our cost over the horizon and may look like overreach. The 60- and 45-day options cost us more. a3 underlines the volume growth it values and a1 anchors its cost; I left out the delivery scorecard to keep the tone cooperative.

decisions.tactician: E0 keeps the 36-month, 90-day terms the supplier has already accepted. It moves the price only slightly, and the sheet is worth just -0.2% to the supplier, so a counter or an acceptance is likely and the risk of a walk-away is low. Health prices around €425 are unrealistic given the freeze, since it held at €432.15 twice. Options o3 to o8 cost us more C, and o9 and o10 are clearly worse. We still have plenty of messages left, and offer:70530-2 remains available to accept as a fallback. The order-history argument is a kind it has not heard yet, and it supports our small ask.
